rows.context_notes: Project 03 ruled on 01 September 2026 that the governed 31 July - 31 August 2026 date meaning is superseded by authoritative CNAD evidence: the exhibition opened 31 July 2026 and is on view until November 2026. The exact November closing day is NOT established and must not be inferred, so the replacement states month-level end meaning only.
rows.linguistic_notes: PT mirrors the EN month-level meaning without introducing a day. “Em exibição até novembro de 2026” is open-ended in the same way “on view until November 2026” is.
